about: Shawn's requirements for the duck answering to its name (namecall.py). One entry per requirement with his words (local time, America/New_York), the acceptance that decides it, the sim tests that guard it and the live evidence. Add a requirement here in the same turn he states or changes one; report progress and the next task from this file (requirements_check.py prints the gaps). status: met (sim tests and a live readback agree), built (code and sim tests pass, no live readback yet), partial (some live evidence, a known failing case), gap (fails live or not built).

Round 3 (22:01, models/oww/mochi_v3.onnx; oww/prep_v3.py, run_v3.sh; clip gate oww/clip_gate.py: 109 of 124 candidate clips pass, 91 read by Whisper; 77 training calls incl. tonight's 17 and calls_221619, 152 RoboClub room chunks as background, calls_200910 0-520 s talk as negatives). Held-out duck calls never trained on (single-stream scorer): v3 21/32 vs v2 18/32 at 0.5 (eight-direction 8/8 vs 7/8, RoboClub calls_201411 2/8 vs 1/8, live_073135 3/5 both, live_141734 late 8/11 vs 7/11); 0 false on 11.7 min held-out talk for both. Per-ear (the robot's scorer, results/compare_v3_20261030.json): tonight's 17 calls 11/17 vs 9/17 (in-sample for v3; the four quietest still score 0.00-0.08), one talk event 0.67, the day's 84 min of life audio 1 false peak at 0.5 (v2: 0). Deployed as the default with threshold 0.7 (repeat 0.3), installed 22:12, not yet live-tested.

2026-10-31 17:11-17:14 first live run of v3 (namecall_20261031-171120.jsonl, per-ear 0.7, --no-person, deployed walk61 brain, home): 3 calls, 3 answers (kw_p 0.96, 0.89, 0.86), 0 false answers in 17:11-17:21; Shawn gave no count of unanswered calls and the A7Z went offline about 17:21 before the life log was pulled, so misses are not yet counted.

2026-10-31 21:07-21:55 round 4 (v4) trained on the Mac mini with 501 motion clips cut from the existing life log (oww/life_motion_bg.py: turns and head sweeps of the 10/30 20:21, 10/30 21:00 and 10/31 20:19 runs, voiced frames masked; two 10/31 turns held out). oww/eval_motion.py, 8 held-out home calls + held-out turn noise, threshold 0.7: at the live post-glue level (-6 dB) v3 3/8, v4 3/8; at 0 dB v3 1/8, v4 2/8; clean 8/8 both. With head-sweep noise at the live level v3 hears 7/8. Cause: during a body turn the voice band at the ears is 4-11 dB louder than a 2 m call (structure-borne: L/R/back coherence 0.3-0.5 under 1.5 kHz, under 0.2 above; same level before and after the glue), so training, a learned-PSD Wiener filter (0-2/8) and a turn-time voice detector (4/8, removed) do not fix it. v4 is the new default (held-out duck calls 22/32 vs 21/32, web 36/170 vs 27/170, false wakes on 28 min speech 1 vs 2, life talk 0 vs 0). results/motion_v3_v4.json.
requirements.gap: Round 3 gains three held-out calls of 32 and two of tonight's 17; the quiet 2 m calls (6-9 dB over the room) stay at 0 even in-sample: with the fixed speech-embedding front end the model is near its ceiling for them, more of the same data will not reach them. Next levers: a soft 'hm?' answer at 0.3-0.7 that invites the repeat the repeat rule then confirms; automatic gated harvesting of every life-log call for later rounds; a front end trained on duck audio. Live test of v3 at 0.7 pending (namecall paused for the t3b run) Calls spoken while the body itself turns are mostly unheard (live-level test 3/8); head sweeps are fine (7/8). Open: a turning behaviour with listening pauses, or isolation of the microphones from structure-borne vibration.

requirements.title: Turns to the caller's side, front first
shawn: 我在前面叫的 它往左边看 还一直转 然后还打滑不停往错误方向转
2026-10-31 20:5x: 不仅要判断准左右 前后也要能判断准 不然我为什么做3个麦克风呢 该训就训 带转身噪音该训就训啊
requirements.acceptance: Live: the first look lands on the caller's side; a call from the front never starts a body turn; a body turn happens only after the front search found nobody.
evidence: bearing_seen labels collect the true bearing of each call for the direction error

eightdir_20261030.json (one call per 45 deg at 2 m): live localiser side right on 5 of 7 side calls, magnitude wrong; whole-word 1.5-6 kHz lags within one 48 kHz sample in every direction (no direction at this level); the 2.5-4 kHz left-right level difference gives the side on 6 of 6 side calls (+3.3, +3.4, +1.2 dB at +45/+90/+135; -0.9, -2.1, -0.4 at -45/-90/-135)
bearing_prior.json (19:48, 15 pairs): side 15/15, magnitude uncorrelated; the pairs after 19:53 are E3 false answers and must be excluded from refits

21:00 live: side matched the camera on 6 of 6 calls where a face/person was then found (ILD overrode the SRP on 21:07:21 and was right); 21:03:09: all cues read right (SRP margin 0.05, LR -2.6 dB, right ear v2 0.93 vs left 0.68), the duck turned right -77 deg, scanned, found nobody, gave up; the calls before and after found Shawn on the left: the wrong turn he reported. Two ILD readings were floor artefacts (-107 dB, 0.0/0.0) and are fixed (10 dB spectral floor, snr >= 3 dB gate)

2026-10-31 17:11-17:14 v3 live, Shawn on the duck's front-left each time (camera found the face at +61, +36, +54 deg): SRP read -57 and -68 deg (right) on calls 2 and 3 and +162 (behind-left) on call 1; the ILD said left on all three (LR +7.0, +11.9, +8.4 dB). Side right 2 of 3: call 2's ILD had snr 2.7 dB, under the 3 dB gate, so the wrong SRP side was used and the face was found only after 7.4 s; call 3's ILD (snr 10.3) overrode the SRP and was right. The SRP is the weaker cue for a front-left caller; the 3 dB SNR gate dropped a correct 11.9 dB ILD.

2026-10-31 20:20-20:22 (after hot glue over the microphone backs and 3 mm wall holes; namecall_20261031-201951.jsonl, camera truths 127, 84, -58 deg, fourth call not found): side right 4 of 4 by the level difference or the lag, but the SRP read -26.8 for a caller at +127 and -133 for one at +84. Over all 12 camera-confirmed calls since 2026-10-30 21:00 the ear pair's lag sign gave the side 12 of 12, the SRP 5 of 12 (fit_bearing.py). Shawn: 明明我在它的正左方，但是它转头只转了一点点，然后要开始来回扫视扫半天才找到我; 它在转头找人的过程中，我再叫它，它就不响应了. Causes: every first look went to the fixed 35.4 deg of the 10/30 prior (true folded bearings since then 32-88, median 61.5); a call during the program's own body turn was skipped by the brain-command gate (20:20:38 skip, 'brain walking with command ... vtheta 0.3'). Fixed 2026-10-31 20:4x, not yet on the A7Z (offline): side = lag sign (|lag| >= 2 samples), then level, then SRP; prior refit to 61.5 deg; a call during the own turn stops the turn and re-aims (tests test_the_ear_pair_delay_decides_the_side_over_the_srp, test_a_new_call_during_the_body_turn_stops_it_and_re_aims). Open: front/back is still unknown from sound (the back microphone read 'front' for the 127 deg caller), and the spotter scored under 0.1 on calls spoken while the body turned (life index scores 20:21:33-20:22:00), so re-aim during a turn needs a turn-noise round of training to be reliable.

2026-10-31 21:0x pair-lag fit (CallLocaliser.pair_fit: the azimuth whose predicted lags best fit the three pairs' own GCC-PHAT lags, peak-weighted Huber 3 samples, el 35): on the 12 camera-confirmed calls since 2026-10-30 21:00 median error 7 deg, 11 of 12 within 30 deg, front/back 11 of 12 (the miss: 127 deg read 77, back pairs peak 0.24/0.16); robust over loss, weighting and elevation choices (median 7-17 deg, 10-11 of 12 within 30); the old SRP median 84 deg, 2 of 12. A call fitted behind with front/back margin >= 2 turns the body at once (fired on 2 of 20 replayed calls, both truly behind). The pre-glue 10/30 eight-direction recording replays worse (median 43 deg; 90 deg read 6): acceptance needs a post-glue eight-direction set. Not yet on the A7Z (offline since about 20:45).
requirements.gap: One side cue in 7 was wrong by 180 deg at home; a single-call side read cannot be made certain at 2 m indoors. Fix in place since 21:21 (not yet live-tested): when the back turn's search finds nobody the body turns on the same way (time cap, about 120 deg) and any turn stops at the first face or person in view (test_a_back_turn_that_finds_nobody_turns_on_until_the_camera_sees_someone). Second eight-direction round still wanted for the level table
